definition.production_kernel: darksirens/likelihood/core.py :: _log_sample_weight_pop_branches, per PE sample s and branch k: log f_k + log p_k(z_s|pix_k,s) + log p_pop(theta_s|Lambda_k); the branches are summed with _mixture_logsumexp and the event likelihood is the sample average (log_evidence_and_mc_variance)
definition.A_k: A_k(s) = log p_k(z_s | pix_{k,s})  -- the SPATIAL factor, the same term the production kernel builds in _eval_prior_branches, minus the log f_k it adds there
definition.B_k: B_k(s) = log p_pop(theta_s | Lambda_k)  -- the INTRINSIC factor, the same log_p_pop call on the same pop_params_all[k]
definition.C: C(s) = -log|d(m1src,q,z)/d(m1det,q,dL)| - log prior_wt_s  -- branch-independent, subtracted once exactly as in production
definition.E: E_i[XY] = (1/n) sum_s exp(A_X(s) + B_Y(s) + C(s)), X,Y in {G,A}, over the SAME samples with the SAME production mask
definition.identity: Z_i = f_GAL E_i[GG] + f_AGN E_i[AA] is the production per-event likelihood
definition.sum_rule: log BF_spatial + log BF_intrinsic = log E[AA] - log E[GG] = log BF_total, exactly
definition.P_AGN: f_AGN E[AA] / (f_GAL E[GG] + f_AGN E[AA]) = sigmoid(log(f_AGN/f_GAL) + log BF_total)
definition.ordering: the split is the chain rule through the AGN-spatial / GAL-intrinsic hybrid E[AG]; the opposite order routes through E[GA] and differs by the interaction term only

ordering_interaction.definition: log E[AA] + log E[GG] - log E[AG] - log E[GA]

caveats: The true host label is a mock diagnostic only; it never enters the likelihood, the decomposition or P_i(AGN).

Seed 100's DETECTED set already separates GAL from AGN in mass ratio q (KS p = 0.0096; z-stratified Fisher 29.57, the largest of 41 seeds examined, median 7.54).  That is the record's own property, present before any mark, and the model holds q identical in both branches, so the branch label is partly identifiable without the spin mark and log BF_intrinsic here is not a clean measurement of the spin mark alone.
One hyperparameter point.  These are not marginalised over the (f_AGN, mu_chi_c2) posterior.
